# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta22

## Map zoom and rotate

- Rename the Visual Editor section to **Map zoom and rotate**.
- Add **Map orientation** with three modes:
  - **Native** — preserves the current card behavior exactly.
  - **North up** — aligns a Single mower map to geographic North using Navimower georeference data; Multi mower is already rendered in the common East/North site frame.
  - **Custom** — applies a user-selected absolute map rotation.
- Show the **Custom rotation** slider only while Custom mode is selected.
- The editor slider covers **-180° … +180°** with a 1° step.
- YAML keeps full numeric precision, so values such as `map_rotation: 12.5` are supported.

## Whole-scene presentation transform

Rotation is applied as a lightweight presentation transform instead of recomputing mower-local geometry.

- Zones, Off-limit/VF-off areas, Channels, Gate/Custom areas, mowing history, current-cycle areas, trails and mower geometry remain aligned.
- OpenStreetMap, Google Satellite, Maa- ja Ruumiamet imagery and LiDAR overlays follow the same presentation rotation.
- Multi mower member alignment remains owned by the Site API and is rotated only after the common-site scene has been assembled.
- Screen UI such as the map legend remains upright.
- Rotated bounds are fitted to the map viewport to avoid clipping corners.
- Mower artwork compensates for that presentation fit so the icon does not unexpectedly shrink.

## Editing and compatibility

- Gate-area editor pointer/local coordinate conversion follows the presentation transform in both Single and Multi mower views.
- **Native** remains the default, so existing cards keep their current orientation.
- If a Single mower has no usable georeference rotation, North up safely leaves the native orientation unchanged.
- No Navimower integration update is required beyond the georeference data already used by the card.
